# Transactions and sessions

## Managed and unmanaged

```ts
await sequelize.transaction(async (transaction) => {
  await Account.decrement('balance', { by: 30, where: { owner: 'ann' }, transaction });
  await Account.increment('balance', { by: 30, where: { owner: 'bob' }, transaction });
});

const failed = await sequelize
  .transaction(async (transaction) => {
    await Account.update({ balance: 0 }, { where: {}, transaction });
    throw new Error('abort');
  })
  .catch((error: Error) => error.message);
// failed === 'abort'; the update was rolled back
```

```ts
const transaction = await sequelize.transaction({
  isolationLevel: Transaction.ISOLATION_LEVELS.REPEATABLE_READ,
});
const committed: string[] = [];
transaction.afterCommit(() => {
  committed.push(transaction.id);
});
try {
  await Account.create({ owner: 'cid', balance: 5 }, { transaction });
  await transaction.commit();
} catch (error) {
  await transaction.rollback();
  throw error;
}
```

## Savepoints

```ts
await sequelize.transaction(async (outer) => {
  await Account.create({ owner: 'dan', balance: 1 }, { transaction: outer });
  await sequelize
    .transaction({ transaction: outer }, async (inner) => {
      await Account.create({ owner: 'eve', balance: 1 }, { transaction: inner });
      throw new Error('rolls back to the savepoint only');
    })
    .catch(() => undefined);
});
// dan is saved, eve is not
```

## Row locks

```ts
const holder = await sequelize.transaction();
await Account.findAll({ where: { owner: 'ann' }, lock: true, transaction: holder });

const free = await sequelize.transaction((worker) =>
  Account.findAll({ lock: Transaction.LOCK.UPDATE, skipLocked: true, transaction: worker }),
);
const noWait = await sequelize
  .transaction((worker) =>
    Account.findAll({ where: { owner: 'ann' }, lock: true, noWait: true, transaction: worker }),
  )
  .catch((error: unknown) => error);
await holder.rollback();
// free: every row except ann's; noWait: DatabaseError (could not obtain lock)
```

## CLS

```ts
Sequelize.useCLS(); // global switch: managed transactions now apply to queries inside the callback
await sequelize.transaction(async () => {
  await User.update({ active: true }, { where: {} }); // runs in the transaction, no option needed
});
```

## Settings, LISTEN/NOTIFY, advisory locks

```ts
const user = await sequelize.transaction(
  { settings: { 'app.user_id': 42, statement_timeout: '5s' } },
  (transaction) =>
    sequelize.query("SELECT current_setting('app.user_id') AS id", {
      type: QueryTypes.SELECT,
      plain: true,
      transaction,
    }),
);
// user: { id: '42' }; the settings end with the transaction (SET LOCAL semantics)
```

```ts
const received: string[] = [];
const unlisten = await sequelize.listen('jobs', (payload, channel) => {
  received.push(`${channel}: ${payload ?? ''}`);
});

await sequelize.notify('jobs', { id: 1 });
await sequelize.transaction(async (transaction) => {
  await Job.create({ name: 'export', state: 'queued' }, { transaction });
  await sequelize.notify('jobs', 'export queued', { transaction }); // delivered on commit
});
await pause(200);
await unlisten();
// received: ['jobs: {"id":1}', 'jobs: export queued']
```

```ts
const holder = await sequelize.transaction();
await holder.advisoryLock('jobs:42');

const other = await sequelize.transaction();
const busy = await other.tryAdvisoryLock('jobs:42'); // false: held by `holder`
const free = await other.tryAdvisoryLock(7); // true: integer keys work too
await holder.commit(); // transaction-level locks are released on commit / rollback
await other.rollback();
```

Read replicas: `new Sequelize({ replication: { read: [...], write } })` routes reads to replicas; see <https://tormozz48.github.io/postgrelize/guide/sessions>.
